preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(char in string.printable for char in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result is a printable character.

postconditions.expression: all(count % 2 == 1 for char, count in Counter(s).items() if count % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result has an odd count in the original string.

postconditions.expression: all(char in result for char in s if s.count(char) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: Each character that has an odd count in the original string is in the result.
The characters in the result are sorted by their last occurrence in the original string.
